design_philosophy: Digital Temple - a premium, warm, spiritual tool for mantra meditation blending sacred tradition with seamless digital interactions. Avoid all 'tech-heavy' aesthetics like glassmorphism or neon.

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-none text-[#7B1C1C]

typography.pairing_rules: Use Cormorant Garamond for all primary headings to invoke a timeless, spiritual feel. Use Poppins for utilitarian UI elements (buttons, nav, numbers). Use Merienda for the live writing canvas to simulate handwriting.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous spacing. Allow sacred elements to breathe. Use Tailwind p-8, p-12, p-16.
spacing_and_layout.homepage_grid: Split layout on desktop: Left column for the Japa Tap Counter (The Focus) and Controls, Right column for the Live Writing Canvas (The Manifestation). Mobile-first: Counter fixed/sticky at bottom or prominent top, canvas below.
spacing_and_layout.container_radius: rounded-2xl to rounded-3xl for soft, approachable containers.

surfaces_and_shadows.canvas: Use the parchment_texture as background image. Apply a soft inner shadow (shadow-inner) to simulate paper depth.
surfaces_and_shadows.cards: Solid cream/off-white (bg-[#FAFAFA]) with a delicate 1px border (#D4AF37/20) and diffuse ambient shadow (shadow-lg with #FF6B00/5 tint). No harsh black shadows.
surfaces_and_shadows.header: Solid #FFF8EE background with a subtle #D4AF37/20 bottom border. No glassmorphism to preserve the organic feel.

animations_and_interactions.tap_button: Pulsating gold glow on idle. On tap: slight scale down (scale-95), ripple effect spreading outward, and circular progress ring smoothly advancing.
animations_and_interactions.writing_canvas: Mantras appear with a fade-in-up or blur-to-sharp effect to mimic ink slowly sinking into paper. Use Framer Motion stagger children for word-by-word reveal.
animations_and_interactions.hover_states: Soft lift (-translate-y-1) and increased shadow for interactive cards. Nav links get a subtle golden underline expansion.
animations_and_interactions.breathing_timer: Expanding and contracting soft circle (scale 1 to 1.5) synced with a 4-7-8 breathing tempo.

components_instructions.japa_tap_button: Custom HTML/SVG or Framer Motion element. Use the lotus_mandala_button as the central graphic inside the button. It must be massive and prominent.
components_instructions.progress_ring: SVG `<circle>` wrapped around the Tap button with `stroke-dasharray` and `stroke-dashoffset` calculated dynamically based on (count % 108). Color: Gradient from Saffron to Gold.
components_instructions.mantra_library: Use Shadcn Cards in a responsive grid (Bento-style). Filter options via Shadcn Tabs.
components_instructions.timer_display: Minimalist digital display (Cormorant Garamond numbers) with standard play/pause Shadcn buttons styled softly.

media_and_assets.icons: Use lucide-react. Prefer rounded, organic-looking icons over sharp technical ones.

instructions_to_main_agent: Inject Google Fonts imports for 'Cormorant Garamond', 'Poppins', 'Merienda', 'Hind Siliguri', and 'Noto Sans Gujarati' into the index.html or global css.
Strictly configure tailwind.config.js with the custom color palette provided here. Discard default shades that clash with the organic feel.

For the Live Writing Canvas: set background-image to 'canvas_texture' URL. Create a state array of tapped mantras. As user clicks the main Tap button, append to array. Render elements using framer-motion `<motion.span>` with blur-to-sharp transitions (e.g. initial={{ opacity: 0, filter: 'blur(4px)' }} animate={{ opacity: 1, filter: 'blur(0px)' }}).
For the Progress Ring: Build an SVG `<circle>` tracking (count % 108). Smoothly animate `stroke-dashoffset` as it updates.
Every interactive element and key informational text (buttons, canvases, timers) MUST include a kebab-case `data-testid` attribute.
Apply `background_pattern` image to the global `body` or wrapper element with `opacity-5` or `opacity-10` to simulate a subtle spiritual texture across the app.
